source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: D227880 explicitly requires checking GetIsServer status even after the reviewer first accepts. The actual landing and fixed Exchange GetDeletable propagate failure before deriving the deletable result from root/special-use state. The override still supplies menu capability; removing an unused earlier call did not mean deleting the override. This is a scoped fallible-output contract, not a live permissions or menu test.
title: Check GetIsServer before using the deletability output
